spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("consumer_fixtures",source/"tests/test_c19_wp24_consumer_states.py")
fx=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(fx)
out={}
for case in fx._SHORT_FLOW_CASES:
    target=root/"fixtures"/case;target.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    p=target/"finra_short_volume/panel.parquet";p.parent.mkdir()
    fx._short_flow_fixture(case).to_parquet(p)
    with MonkeyPatch.context() as mp:
        mp.setattr(fx.config,"data_dir",lambda:target)
        panel,state=fx.sv.panel_state();assert state==fx.sv.OBSERVED
        direct=fx.sv.signal_map(panel);assert direct and direct==fx.sf._load_short_volume()
        out[case]=fx.sf._positioning("AAA",fx._F,None,None,direct["AAA"])
(root/"fixture-positioning.json").write_text(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False,indent=2)+"\n")
subprocess.run(["node",str(root/"audit_consumer.cjs"),"../producer-proof/after-audit/positioning.json"],check=True)
print("FINRA_CONSUMER_AUDIT_COMPLETE",flush=True)
